title: AIPACK agent:composition predicate payload
description: Payload for urn:agent:composition:v1 attestation. Records the canonical slot table and composite digest for an Agent (C1) artifact.

agentRef.description: OCI digest ref of the assembled Agent.

compositeDigest.description: RFC 8785 canonical JSON sha256 over the slot table.

slots.description: Slot name → OCI digest ref map. All refs must be digest-pinned (AIPACK-COMP-001).
